name: Patmos

related_people.name: John
related_people.role: exiled to this island, where he received the visions of Revelation

description: A small Aegean island where the apostle John was exiled "because of the word of God" and where he received the visions recorded in the book of Revelation (Revelation 1:9-11).
family_friendly_summary: Patmos is a small, rocky island in the Aegean Sea. The apostle John was sent there as a prisoner because he preached about Jesus. While on Patmos, John received the visions from God that he wrote down in the book of Revelation.
